rationale: This is a theft of belongings during the covered trip, reported to the Buenos Aires tourist police the same afternoon (within the 24 hours required by section 5 of the wording), with receipts for the items over $100, so Baggage and Personal Effects pays. The manual's interpretation note confirms a snatch from the person is never "unattended belongings". Per-item limits apply: the e-reader counts at $180 because the Electronics Plus add-on lifts its limit, but the headphones and game console are not electronics listed in section 8, so each is capped at the Premium $300 limit and the tote at $95 — $875, less the $50 Premium deductible, giving $825, which is under the $1,500 benefit maximum.
